> Written for blit386 1.7.1. The rest of blit386.dev documents the newest engine, so an API you find there may be missing from a game pinned to 1.7.1.

Everything needed to write a BLIT386 game from scratch, with no project on disk yet. Every page here can be read through the blit386-docs MCP server: find it with `search_docs`, read it with `get_doc_page`.

## Quickest start

`npm create blit386@latest my-game` creates the whole project, with these same guides, skills, and rules already on disk.

## Without the scaffolder

1. Write the four files on the [Starter Template](/docs/build-a-game/starter-template) page into an empty folder.
2. Run `npm install`, then `npm run dev`.
3. Read [AGENTS.md](/docs/build-a-game/agents) - the rules every BLIT386 game follows.
4. Replace the starter game in `src/game.js` with your own, using the skills below for each feature.
